text:
maya: Hey team, just got a live report from a customer — free-trial credits didn't apply after support console grant. Customer saw a success UI but balance is 0 and API calls immediately returned 402. Ticket #CS-9221. 

jason: Can you paste the support-console request ID and the promo code used?

maya: req_id=rcg_20260315_9f7a, promo=TRIAL50. In the admin audit it shows 'GRANT_REQUESTED' -> 'GRANT_ROLLED_BACK' with a note 'txn_conflict'. Screenshot attached in the ticket. :eyes:

jason: Hmm. We had a dedupe change recently in the backoffice job, could be related. Priya, any infra side logs for that req_id?

priya: I pulled the backoffice logs around rcg_20260315_9f7a. There's a 500 on the grant API: 
```
POST /admin/grants rcg_20260315_9f7a 500 
error: grant_action: failed to commit: pq: could not serialize access due to concurrent update
stack: /app/services/grant_service.go:142
```
Looks like a serialization failure causing the transaction to abort and the request to be marked rolled back.

dennis: We merged a change last week to de-duplicate grants by customer+promo before commit. That code path now races with the async dedupe worker that reconciles tombstones. If both touch the same row, you can get serialization errors. Could explain 'txn_conflict'.

jason: Can we repro locally? Steps requested by support lead: create a customer, apply same promo concurrently from the console and via the dedupe job. If serialization shows up we'll confirm.

priya: Repro steps I used: 
1) create test account (acct_test_834) 
2) hit admin grants endpoint twice concurrently: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"acct":"acct_test_834","promo":"TRIAL50"}' https://admin.internal/api/v1/grants &
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"acct":"acct_test_834","promo":"TRIAL50"}' https://admin.internal/api/v1/grants &
wait
```
Result: one returned 201, the other 500 with 'could not serialize access'.

maya: Customer-facing ask: they want credits applied ASAP. Any safe manual fix?

dennis: We can manually insert a credit row for now but must be careful to avoid duplication. SQL I ran for test: 
```sql
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO credits (acct_id, amount, reason, promo_code, created_by) 
SELECT id, 5000, 'trial-promo-manual-fix', 'TRIAL50', 'support/maya' FROM accounts WHERE external_id='acct_customer_129';
COMMIT;
```
Verify with: 
```sql
SELECT balance FROM account_balances WHERE acct_id=(SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE external_id='acct_customer_129');
```
Do NOT run on prod without an ops review.

priya: Agreed. I'll schedule a short maintenance window and a quick rollback patch to make the grant code retry on serialization instead of marking rolled back. Small change: wrap commit with an exponential backoff retry for serialization errors.

maya: I'll warn the customer about a temporary manual apply if they'd like immediate access, otherwise we'll schedule fix and keep them updated.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-74 - support console grant race causing rolled-back credits. Assigned to eng-infra, priority=P2.

deploy-bot: Deployed candidate fix branch release/credit-dedupe-retry to staging at 2026-03-15T18:12:02Z. Please validate.

dennis: I'll validate on staging and run the concurrent grant script. If green we'll push hotfix to prod during the maintenance window.

jason: Thanks. maya, please paste the customer's acct external id in the ticket and whether they want manual apply now. I'll coordinate the manual DB insert and mark the support action.

maya: Added acct_customer_129 and customer confirmed they'd like immediate apply. Proceeding with manual workflow once ops approves. :thumbsup:

priya: Ops approved. Dennis, go ahead but add audit metadata 'manual_fix_by=support/maya cs_ticket=CS-9221' in the insert. After that, I'll roll the retry fix and monitor for duplicates.

dennis: Manual insert completed and verified balance update. Customer notified and CS updated ticket. Will monitor logs for retries/failures over next 2 hours.

maya: Customer confirmed credits showed up and charges are unblocked. Leaving thread open until hotfix is prod-deployed. :tada:

priya: Noted. Created PR to add 3 retry attempts on serialization errors + metric. Plan: prod deploy in next 2 hours post smoke tests.

jason: Great work. Leaving notes in CS-9221 about root cause (race between grant de-duplication and dedupe worker) and remediation steps.

maya: Closing loop once PR is in prod. Thanks everyone.
